title: Brooklyn Sail

services.name: Day Sail
services.desc: Book as many seats as you like (up to 6) on this 2-hour morning or afternoon sail. Our Captain and Crew will take you through Presque Isle Bay and into Lake Erie (as wind permits) while you enjoy a glass of wine, charcuterie, good conversation, and gorgeous views! Leave life at shore and lose yourself in the moment as the birds cry from above, fish flop in warm summer water, and trees dance together in the wind. Experience the inherent peacefulness of sailing for yourself because this summer should be remembered forever. We handpicked a boat with your comfort in mind.
